name: Teach Me Onegai!~
source:
It's graduation day and Semel Brösel has to say goodbye to the crush he harbored for three whole years: his computer science teacher Luke Onegai.

Or doesn't he?
Could he finally get himself to confess his feelings?

Either way, this evening will be something to remember.
For both of them...

[From [url=https://boyslaughplus.itch.io/teach-me-onegai]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
毕业日到了，Semel Brösel必须告别他暗恋了整整三年的人：他的计算机科学老师Luke Onegai。

或者他不是？
他终于可以让自己坦白自己的感情了吗？

不管怎样，今晚将是值得纪念的事情。
对于他们俩来说…

[来自[url=https://boyslaughplus.itch.io/teach-me-onegai]itch.io[/url]]
